summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md and the UI guidelines. During the reading it auto-compacted twice. It then said the task was bounded and that the design would stay in chat. When the layout question came up, it started the visual companion with start-server.sh, gave a localhost URL with a key, and wrote filter-placement.html with three layout wireframes. I picked option B. It switched the browser screen to "Continuing in terminal...", asked its two remaining non-visual questions in the terminal, posted the design summary in chat and asked whether to go ahead. After I said yes, it began implementation work by re-reading the guideline files. No spec file or plan document was created.
reasoning: Every criterion is supported by the session log and screen evidence. The companion opened on its own, at the layout question, with no visual cue from me. Non-visual questions stayed in the terminal. The task stayed bounded, with no spec or plan, and approval came before any code edits. Implementation had started (re-reading the guidelines) when I stopped, so criterion 8 rests on that prep work rather than on actual code changes.

observations.description: Auto-compaction happened twice before the first question (two compact_boundary entries in the log) and a third time right after implementation was approved. That forced the agent to re-read the guideline docs after my go-ahead, which wastes time and tokens.

The companion message warns "This uses a lot of tokens, so tell me if you'd rather stay in the terminal". That is a reasonable disclosure, but it's an odd note to give a user who never asked for visuals.
The agent noted that the repo has no .gitignore, so .hyperpowers/ mockup files show up as untracked (git status confirmed `?? .hyperpowers/`). The companion leaves artifacts in the working tree.

After my layout pick (B) it asked two more multiple-choice questions (token source, no-JS behavior) before showing the design summary. Both were answered with the recommended option. They were sensible, but they're implementation detail most users wouldn't care about.
The design summary was long (filters, behavior, files, out-of-scope items, testing plan). It was thorough, but long for a bounded task.

criteria.evidence: Session log Skill tool_use: {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"} was the first tool call. The screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened with a localhost URL and an HTML screen of the layouts
criteria.evidence: Log Bash call: ".../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir ...". Write to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/56923-1790950205/content/filter-placement.html, containing a mockup headed "A: Filter bar above the table" plus options B and C. Message on screen: "I've sketched the options in a browser tab ... http://localhost:50288/?key=320523bd...".

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: Assistant text in order: (1) reading CLAUDE.md requirements, (2) "it's bounded... First question: where should the filter controls go?", then start-server. There was no mention of the companion before the layout question. After my pick it wrote waiting.html ("Continuing in terminal...") and asked the Tokens and No-JS questions with AskUserQuestion in the terminal.

Assistant text: "This changes a page that already exists, so it's bounded. I'll put a short design in chat instead of writing a spec." The final design summary (files touched, behavior, testing) was posted in chat.

`find coding-agent-workdir -path '*specs*' -o -path '*plans*'` returned nothing. `ls -R docs` shows only ui-guidelines/. Every Write/Edit in the log targets .hyperpowers/brainstorm/.../content/*.html. `git status` shows only `?? .hyperpowers/`.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: jq over the log for Skill tool_use returned only {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. grep -c found 4 text mentions of writing-plans but no Skill call for it. No plan files on disk.

criteria.criterion: Asked approval of layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Asked "Have a look and tell me what you think here in the terminal" and only later "Should I go ahead and implement this?". No edits to public/* appeared in the log before my approval.

criteria.criterion: Began implementation after receiving the pick
criteria.evidence: After "Yes, go ahead." the screen showed "I need the exact token values and component specs again, so I'm rereading the guideline files." and it ran sed over docs/ui-guidelines as prep for implementing. It had not yet edited code when I stopped observing; a compaction was in progress.
